rules: GML is an open format used across Europe and compliant with the EU INSPIRE Directive.
HM Land Registry uses GML to provide a standard structure for GIS and CAD users.
Official guidance lists ESRI Shapefile as a GML conversion target.
Official guidance lists MapInfo MIF or TAB as GML conversion targets.
Official guidance lists AutoCAD DXF as a GML conversion target.
Official guidance lists GeoJSON as a GML conversion target.
Official guidance lists KML as a GML conversion target.
Google or Bing map use requires reprojection from British National Grid.
The guidance names WGS 84 Pseudo-Mercator EPSG:3857 as a web-map target CRS.
Polygon vertices are represented by X and Y values referenced to British National Grid.
A monthly publication contains data from the preceding month.
An INSPIRE ID can be used with Find a Property to obtain title registration and plan information.
Exact current Barnet and Enfield GML hrefs, bytes and hashes were not captured.
Current INSPIRE IDs and native-BNG containment for the three candidates remain unresolved.
The API exposes more than 100 planning and housing datasets through one interface.
Latitude and longitude return entities whose geometries intersect the constructed point.
A coordinate query may include multiple dataset parameters.
The official guide says a UPRN query is more precise for registered properties.
Coordinate and custom geometry requests use WGS84 EPSG:4326.
Responses provide next, previous, first and last pagination links.
Bulk downloads are recommended for large portfolios because they avoid rate limits and provide a stable snapshot.
The documentation identifies Parquet as suitable for large datasets.
The entity endpoint documents reference as an array filter.
The entity endpoint documents quality as an array filter.
field selections take precedence over exclude_field selections.
within is an allowed geometry_relation value.
intersects is an allowed geometry_relation value.
contains is an allowed geometry_relation value.

Authoritative UPRNs for the three candidates remain unavailable.
The DTM combines Time Stamped archive and National LIDAR Programme surveys.
Source surveys are merged and resampled to provide the best possible coverage.
Metadata index catalogues identify the survey used at a location.
Data is supplied as GeoTIFF rasters in 5km tiles aligned to the OS National Grid.
Heights are in metres to Ordnance Datum Newlyn using OSTN15.
Input LIDAR surveys have stated vertical accuracy of plus or minus 15cm RMSE.
The dataset metadata records annual update frequency.
The dataset is licensed under the Open Government Licence.
The yearless DTM 1m WCS endpoint is intended to remain persistent across updates.
WMS provides a summarised display while WCS provides elevation data.
WCS 2.0.1 is the documented open-standard route for raw pixel values.
The GetCapabilities XML and exact DTM coverage identifier could not be parsed in this runtime.
Exact TQ2892 pixels and their source-survey index records remain unavailable.
Terrain 50 is a lower-resolution DTM intended for landscape visualisation and analysis.
Official documentation states Terrain 50 grid data is verified to 4m RMSE.
The product is maintained through an integrated 3-to-5-year flying programme.
The source terrain model is a triangulated irregular network using mass points and breaklines.
Grid and contour products are both interpolated from the same source TIN.
A 10km tile is identified from the National Grid reference of its south-west corner.
GML features and geometries have unique identifiers within a product release.
Sequential identifiers are regenerated when a whole tile is refreshed.
The documentation states there are no plans for feature-based change-only updates.
Terrain 50 GML expresses its CRS as urn:ogc:def:crs:EPSG::27700.
Terrain 50 provides GEMINI-standard XML metadata on a per-tile basis.
The same auxiliary min, max, mean and standard-deviation values are supplied for every tile.
The exact live Terrain50 area=TQ API response was not captured because runtime DNS failed.
The current TQ29 archive contents and hashes remain unavailable.
The actual target cell values for the three candidates remain unavailable.
